        ]}\n      />\n    ),\n    table: (\n      <div className=\"p-6 bg-surface rounded-lg shadow-sm space-y-6\">\n        <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleSave(); }} className=\"space-y-6\">\n          <Input label=\"Title\" name=\"title\" value={paintingData.title} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Artist\" name=\"artist\" value={paintingData.artist} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Medium\" name=\"medium\" value={paintingData.medium} onChange={handleChange} required />\n          <Input label=\"Dimensions\" name=\"dimensions\" value={paintingData.dimensions} onChange={handleChange} placeholder=\"e.g., 30x40 inches\" required />\n          <Input label=\"Year\" name=\"year\" type=\"text\" value={paintingData.year} onChange={handleChange} required />\
          <Input label=\"Price\" name=\"price\" type=\"text\" value={paintingData.price} onChange={handleChange} placeholder=\"e.g., 4500.00\" required />\
          <Select\n            label=\"Availability Status\"\n            name=\"availability\"\n            options={[\n              { value: \"Available\", label: \"Available\" },\n              { value: \"Sold\", label: \"Sold\" },\n              { value: \"On Hold\", label: \"On Hold\" },\
            ]}\n            value={paintingData.availability}\n            onValueChange={(value) => setPaintingData({ ...paintingData, availability: value })}\
